skills.guide: Engineering workflow: reproduce the reported failure, distinguish observations from hypotheses, inspect the smallest relevant source, test a specific hypothesis before proposing a change, then verify the behavior and relevant regressions. skills.guide: Engineering workflow: review the supplied current source/diff against the requested behavior and repository rules. Include uncommitted changes when supplied. Report concrete actionable defects with file and line, impact, and evidence; distinguish verified behavior, inference and unrun checks. Do not invent missing files or claim to have run tests. Prioritize correctness and regressions. Return a concise review and limitations. A review does not authorize edits, commits, remote messages or publication.

skills.name: 需求到任务计划
skills.use_when: 整理需求、编写功能规格、把需求拆成可验收任务与依赖。
skills.do_not_use_when: 闲聊、仅解释规格概念、已明确只需一句回答；不执行工单发布。
skills.guide: Workflow: synthesize supplied requirements into a bounded specification, then demoable vertical task slices. Reuse stated decisions, vocabulary and stage order; resolve contradictions explicitly. Each task has an observable deliverable, acceptance criteria and only genuine blockers. Keep dependencies acyclic. For broad mechanical migrations use expand, migrate, contract. Mark missing facts and assumptions; ask only blocking questions, never repeat answered ones. The deliverable is a draft in chat or the registered text-report task, not published tickets. No tracker access, file edits or test runs are implied. In the final output give each task its own ID, observable acceptance and explicit Blocked by field (None or earlier task IDs). Sequence alone is not a dependency declaration. Under length limits reduce the number of tasks, retaining these fields. The first slice must demonstrate a usable end-to-end behavior, not just a database or UI layer.
positive_examples: 把离线笔记需求整理成规格和任务计划

skills.name: 概念讲解与练习
skills.use_when: 针对一个概念提供分层讲解、例子与理解练习。

skills.guide: Workflow: teach one bounded concept aligned with the stated learner and goal. Start with a concrete example, then the mechanism and its limits. Use consistent terms; when simplifying, name the assumption so an analogy is not mistaken for reality. Include a short retrieval or transfer exercise and an answer with reasoning, clearly separated so the learner can try first. If the learner is confused, re-explain using a different concrete example rather than repeating jargon. Use supplied sources; mark uncertain or unavailable citations. This is a text lesson, not an interactive app, persistent course or verified mastery assessment.

skills.name: 需求调研问卷
skills.use_when: 用户要求把待决定问题整理成给他人填写的问卷
skills.do_not_use_when: 已能回答的问题、普通任务；不自动发送给他人
skills.guide: Workflow: draft a discovery questionnaire around a decision and the information gap between the user and the recipient. Reuse supplied recipient role, purpose and constraints; ask only if an essential gap prevents useful drafting. Order questions by decision importance, one idea per question, group related questions, provide answer space and allow unknown or partial answers. Include enough context for an absent recipient. Cover each named decision; avoid leading questions, irrelevant demographics and unnecessary sensitive data. Output a draft; do not claim it was sent or responses collected. Each numbered item asks exactly one thing; split volume, proportion, examples and time into separate items. Under a short output budget use fewer prioritized questions, never compress several questions into one item.

skills.guide: Workflow: write or revise agent instructions for the requested scope. Make discovery text discriminate real triggering tasks from near misses. skills.name: 软件结构与行为解析
skills.use_when: 分析所选 JavaScript / Electron 目录或 ASAR 包的模块、桥接 API、IPC 调用链，按标识符关注证据。
skills.do_not_use_when: 概念问答、机械拆解、源码修改；EXE、APK 和运行时跟踪未接通；不能从客户端还原云端代码或模型权重。
skills.guide: 对用户明确选择的 JavaScript / Electron 应用目录或 ASAR 包执行固定 REA 静态分析。核对输入范围和证据编号，引用关系源位置；区分语法事实、静态推导与未验证运行行为。读取完整证据的限制与排除项。目标代码不执行，未发现不代表不存在。目录不自动上传模型。需要复刻时先整理行为规格，再交给编程技能。 可选 focus 为通道名、文件名等字面标识符；匹配为空不能认定功能不存在。ASAR 解析经过筛选的文本快照，保留容器摘要和成员来源。

用 REA 解析这个客户端的软件结构
分析 ASAR 中的 fixture:op1 通道
negative_examples: 介绍 REA 逆向工具
